name: Invite members
summary: Invite several people at once: emails become removable chips, one role applies to all with a line on what it can do, and a seat count shows what the invites use.
use: when adding people to a workspace or team
a11y: The email field is a labelled input; each chip has a remove button that names the address, Backspace removes the last chip, the role is a native select described by its explanation, and errors are tied to the field.

use_when: a plan with a seat limit, where people need to see what the invites will use before sending
avoid_when: managing people who are already members: use member-list
sharing one item by link or app: use share-sheet
signing a single person in: use sign-in-form

parts.name: title
parts.what: who is being invited to what

parts.name: emails
parts.what: one address as a removable chip; red when it is not a full address

parts.name: email_input
parts.what: where addresses are typed or pasted

parts.name: hint
parts.what: how to add addresses, or which one is wrong

parts.name: role_desc
parts.what: what the chosen role can and cannot do

parts.name: seats
parts.what: a bar of seats in use and seats these invites take, with a sentence

parts.name: send
parts.what: send the invites, with the count in the label

empty.how: when every chip is removed the hint goes back to how to add addresses and Send is disabled

loading.how: after Send, disable both buttons and the field and change the label to 'Sending' until the result comes back

error.how: an address that is not a full email turns into a red chip and the hint names it; over the seat limit the seat line says how many to remove

disabled.how: Send turns grey and cannot be pressed with no valid address or too many for the seats left

overflow.how: chips wrap onto new rows and the field grows; it has no height limit, so a long pasted list makes the dialog tall
overflow.evidence: flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--ds-space-stack-md) var(--ds-space-inline-sm)

long_text.how: a long address ends in an ellipsis inside its chip; the remove button stays visible
long_text.evidence: .odl-chip > span { min-inline-size: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis

keyboard: Tab reaches each chip's remove button, the email field, the role choice, Cancel, then Send
Enter or comma in the email field turns what was typed into a chip; leaving the field does the same
Backspace in an empty email field removes the last chip
Enter or Space on a chip's remove button removes that address
Arrow keys change the role, as in any native select, and the line under it updates
